name: softmax is stable and column scaling is independent
test:
import numpy as np
values = stable_softmax(np.array([[1000., 1001.], [-1000., -999.]]))
assert np.isfinite(values).all() and np.allclose(values.sum(axis=1), 1)
scaled = standardize_columns(np.array([[1., 10.], [2., 20.], [3., 30.]]))
assert np.allclose(scaled.mean(axis=0), 0)
try:
    standardize_columns(np.array([[1., 2.], [1., 3.]]))
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('constant column must raise')

name: ridge leaves the bias unpenalized
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[1., 0.], [0., 1.]])
y = np.array([1., -1.])
no_penalty = ridge_gradient(X, y, np.array([2., -2.]), 0.5, 0.0)
with_penalty = ridge_gradient(X, y, np.array([2., -2.]), 0.5, 3.0)
assert np.allclose(with_penalty[0] - no_penalty[0], np.array([12., -12.]))
assert with_penalty[1] == no_penalty[1]
